subject: Issue in Ubuntu with sudo apt-get install r-cran-package

messages.author: a330fd4a9ddb1da4
messages.subject: Issue in Ubuntu with sudo apt-get install r-cran-package
parts:
Hello,

When I used : sudo apt-get install r-cran-rgl ; MRO has been uninstall in profit of R 3.2.2.

I had to reinstall MRO.

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: Issue in Ubuntu with sudo apt-get install r-cran-package
parts:
Hello,

I don't think it should uninstall Microsoft R Open. However, it probably replaced the sym link in /usr/bin with one pointing to the package you installed second.

messages.author: d66af5beeea3ef4a
messages.subject: Re: Issue in Ubuntu with sudo apt-get install r-cran-package
parts:
I have the same issue and it was solved by:

       cd /usr/bin
       sudo rm /usr/bin/R
       sudo ln -s '/usr/lib64/MRO-3.2.4/R-3.2.4/lib/R/bin/R'  R
